integrity: The finite-depth vertex generating function and Catalan input are explicitly credited to prior work. The asymptotic limit and cutoff argument are supplied independently, with source-coverage risks stated; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise linear-depth parameter only; the sub-half regime has zero limit on the stated scale but its finer exponent is not determined. No uniformity at parameter boundaries, no statements about higher-dimensional face counts.
title: A two-block phase transition in Catalan-pellytope vertex growth
